snippets.KAMARIA_TRANSITION_01: Hello $$name$$! How are things with you?
snippets.KAMARIA_TRANSITION_03: Oh dear, I'm sorry. My nose is itching! And that usually doesn't mean anything good, I tell you.
snippets.KAMARIA_TRANSITION_04: Every time my nose is itching something bad is about to happen!
snippets.KAMARIA_TRANSITION_05: Have you seen the grey clouds above Panfu? I'm afraid these clouds are bringing something bad with them. But what could it be?
snippets.KAMARIA_TRANSITION_07: See that telescope over there? I put it there so each Panda could keep an eye on the clouds and notice if there's anything shady going on.
snippets.KAMARIA_TRANSITION_08: It's best you look through the telescope every day. Maybe you can see something different?
snippets.KAMARIA_TRANSITION_09: Be careful, little Panda! Something is going on...
snippets.KAMARIA_TRANSITION_10: It's a disaster! Paul the kid is gone!
snippets.KAMARIA_TRANSITION_11: HE IS GONE!!! Do you know what that means? Danger!
snippets.KAMARIA_TRANSITION_12: Paul the kid is no normal child. He has supernatural powers in him, and they can easily be used for the wrong things!
snippets.KAMARIA_TRANSITION_13: Someone could use his powers to do something evil! We must get Paul back into his room, that's the only place he's safe!
snippets.KAMARIA_TRANSITION_15: The dark clouds are making the search impossible. That's why we need to try to banish them. I already have an idea how...
snippets.KAMARIA_TRANSITION_16: Can you see this windmill over here? With the windmill we can blow away the clouds!
snippets.KAMARIA_TRANSITION_17: It's just not easy to make the windmill spin. At least 5 Pandas should twirl around at once.
snippets.KAMARIA_TRANSITION_18: That's why I've made it possible for all Pandas to make a tornado. Just click on the windmill and try it out!
snippets.KAMARIA_TRANSITION_19: When you and at least 4 other Pandas spin as tornados the windmill will start to turn. And if we're lucky it will blow the clouds away too.
snippets.KAMARIA_TRANSITION_20: It's best you stop by a few times a day, and activate the windmill together with other Pandas.
snippets.KAMARIA_TRANSITION_21: And don't forget to look through the telescope every day!
snippets.KAMARIA_TRANSITION_22: I'll stay here for now and keep guard.
snippets.KAMARIA_TRANSITION_23: Good luck, young Panda! I'll keep my fingers crossed for us all!
snippets.KAMARIA_TRANSITION_24: It's best you stop by a few times a day, and activate the windmill together with other Pandas. That way you can blow away the clouds, and it's easier to look for Paul.
snippets.KAMARIA_TRANSITION_25: Please, I'm begging you, help me find Paul the kid!
snippets.KAMARIA_TRANSITION_26: To make the windmill spin you need at least 5 Pandas to twirl in a tornado. So bring a few friends with you and start spinning!
snippets.KAMARIA_TRANSITION_27: So far so good, small Panda! You made the windmill spin. Well done!
snippets.KAMARIA_TRANSITION_28: Tomorrow we'll see if the clouds have shifted further away so we can get a better view through the telescope.
snippets.KAMARIA_TRANSITION_29: So today we can just sit back and relax.
snippets.KAMARIA_TRANSITION_30: When you come back tomorrow you should look through the telescope right away.
snippets.KAMARIA_TRANSITION_32: Hello $$name$$! Did you look into the telescope yet?
snippets.KAMARIA_TRANSITION_33: What a disaster!!! Evron has lured Paul the kid with a giant pancake, and is now using his magic powers!
snippets.KAMARIA_TRANSITION_34: Please look into the telescope and you'll see what I mean.
snippets.KAMARIA_TRANSITION_35: See?!? We're all in danger, little Panda!
snippets.KAMARIA_TRANSITION_36: Paul the kid was apparently tempted by the giant pancake and is now doing everything he can to pull it towards himself...
snippets.KAMARIA_TRANSITION_37: He's craving for the pancake so much that he's pulling the whole Bitterland towards Panfu! And its inhabitants too!
snippets.KAMARIA_TRANSITION_38: You should know: In Bitterland lives a man called Evron - he's a very very vicious Panda.
snippets.KAMARIA_TRANSITION_39: And how do I know about him? One day I'll tell you... perhaps. But now is too soon.
snippets.KAMARIA_TRANSITION_40: But I can tell you this: There's no joking around with Evron! He's a very powerful and scary Panda who knows how to use others' weeknesses against them.
snippets.KAMARIA_TRANSITION_41: So now we must do everything we can to keep Panfu from clashing with Bitterland. Should we fail, Evron could settle here and start doing his bad deeds allover Panfu!!!
snippets.KAMARIA_TRANSITION_42: The peace on our beautiful island is at risk!
snippets.KAMARIA_TRANSITION_43: We must wake Paul the kid up as soon as we can! Maybe you should give him a cold shower!
snippets.KAMARIA_TRANSITION_45: Gather at least 5 Pandas together quickly. Stand on the castle terrace and throw as many water balloons towards Paul the kid as you can.
snippets.KAMARIA_TRANSITION_46: Those water balloons need to really be raining on him! The more Pandas you can get, the better! One of those water balloons must reach him!
snippets.KAMARIA_TRANSITION_47: But please hurry! It could be too late at any moment.
snippets.KAMARIA_TRANSITION_50: I know you did your best! You're a very brave Panda indeed. So brave you've earned a medal!
snippets.KAMARIA_TRANSITION_51: You managed to wake Paul the kid up... but unfortunately it was too late already. Bitterland and Panfu are now tied together forever. Evron is now among us.
snippets.KAMARIA_TRANSITION_52: But don't you worry, little Panda! I will make sure nothing bad happens to you.
snippets.KAMARIA_TRANSITION_53: Together we'll stand up to Evron to keep peace on Panfu.
snippets.KAMARIA_TRANSITION_54: So please stay alert, young Panda!
snippets.KAMARIA_TRANSITION_55: Here you go, have your bravery medal. You sincerely deserved it. Carry it with pride!
snippets.KAMARIA_TRANSITION_56: I'll go bring Paul the kid home now. Good bye, small Panda!
snippets.LOUDSPEAKER_TRANSITION: Attention! Attention! The little boy Paul the kid is missing! All Pandas are asked to gather on the castle terrace!
snippets.PAUL_TRANSITION_01: Mmmm... delicious! That's my favourite food.
snippets.PAUL_TRANSITION_03: No pancakes left? What a shame...
snippets.TROY_TRANSITION_01: Hi! In the mood for pancakes?
snippets.TROY_TRANSITION_02: Oh, my name is Troy and this is my pancake shop. Cool, huh?
snippets.TROY_TRANSITION_03: I built it with my own paws! It wasn't easy.
snippets.TROY_TRANSITION_04: Once I hit myself with a hammer in the thumb so hard it swelled up to 3 times its size. I couldn't make pancakes for 3 whole weeks.
snippets.TROY_TRANSITION_06: Now my thumb has shrunken back to its normal size and I can use the pan easily again. Neat!
snippets.TROY_TRANSITION_07: Oh yes, you wanted to have a pancake. But did you wash your paws?
snippets.TROY_TRANSITION_08: Well then, I'll close my eyes this once. Help yourself!
snippets.TROY_TRANSITION_10: Oh, by the way, there's only one pancake per hour.
snippets.TROY_TRANSITION_12: Do you see the clock above the booth? It counts the minutes to the next pancake fight!
snippets.TROY_TRANSITION_13: You heard right. When the clock has counted down to zero you can throw as many pancakes as you'd like! But just for a while!
snippets.TROY_TRANSITION_15: But don't leave the place all messy!
snippets.TROY_TRANSITION_17: Be careful so you don't slip on a pancake!
snippets.TROY_TRANSITION_18: Tell me, can you see Paul here somewhere? Many call him "Paul the kid"...
snippets.TROY_TRANSITION_20: That little fellow is a sweetheart but also quite the binge eater! He comes here every day and binges on pancakes.
snippets.TROY_TRANSITION_21: I've never seen anyone more into pancakes than him!
snippets.TROY_TRANSITION_22: It's like there's something strange about him... Every time Paul the kid comes close to my shop it starts to shake! Like there was an earth quake!
snippets.TROY_TRANSITION_23: We should definitely keep an eye on him!
snippets.TROY_TRANSITION_24: I don't really know what's happening but it sure isn't normal!
snippets.TROY_TRANSITION_25: Don't you believe me? Puh! I'll prove it to you!
snippets.TROY_TRANSITION_26: Here, have a pan with a pancake. Go and give it to Paul the kid.
snippets.TROY_TRANSITION_27: His room is in the castle above Kamaria.
snippets.TROY_TRANSITION_28: Stick the pancake in front of his nose and you'll see magic!
snippets.TROY_TRANSITION_29: And don't tell me I didn't warn you!
snippets.TROY_TRANSITION_30: Did you go to Paul the kid yet? Hold the pancake pan in front of his nose and see what happens!
snippets.TROY_TRANSITION_31: This little fellow is no normal Panda!
snippets.TROY_TRANSITION_32: Did you see how Paul the kid moved the furniture?
snippets.TROY_TRANSITION_33: This little Panda has supernatural powers!
snippets.TROY_TRANSITION_34: Hey, don't miss the pancake fight! It'll rock! It starts when the timer goes down to zero.
snippets.TROY_TRANSITION_35: Have you washed your hands too?
snippets.TROY_TRANSITION_38: Oh, sorry. Hello $$name$$! Are you wondering what's going on here?
snippets.TROY_TRANSITION_39: I slept in my shop today because I was so tired I fell asleep standing up...
snippets.TROY_TRANSITION_40: ...and when I woke up the shop wasn't in the city anymore - but here!
snippets.TROY_TRANSITION_41: And that's not even the whole story. Someone had stolen all my Pancakes!
snippets.TROY_TRANSITION_42: What's happening here? I'm totally confused...
snippets.TROY_TRANSITION_43: But anyways, the business must stay running! I'll start working now so we have fresh pancakes tomorrow!
snippets.TROY_TRANSITION_44: I'll let my shop stand here for now. I don't feel like carrying heavy stuff around right now.
snippets.TROY_TRANSITION_45: But do you know what? You could do me one small favor if you'd like.
snippets.TROY_TRANSITION_47: ...but I have a bad feeling... Could you come and check up on me tomorrow? That would be sweet. See you then!
snippets.TROY_TRANSITION_49: Oh, hello $$name$$! Do you notice anything strange?
snippets.TROY_TRANSITION_50: The shop has been moved again!! And someone has taken all the pancakes I managed to make yesterday!
snippets.TROY_TRANSITION_51: I'm not losing my mind, am I? You can see it too, right?
snippets.TROY_TRANSITION_52: Woah, that's good to know! I thought I've got one screw loose!
snippets.TROY_TRANSITION_53: All my screws are on tight but the pancakes have ran away!
snippets.TROY_TRANSITION_54: Nothing's going to help. I just need to make new ones.
snippets.TROY_TRANSITION_55: I'll mix the dough ready and start baking. Come back tomorrow for some pancakes.
snippets.TROY_TRANSITION_56: I won't move from this place... I hope.
snippets.TROY_TRANSITION_60: Every day the same happens: My shop moves from one place to the next. How is that even possible?!#
snippets.TROY_TRANSITION_62: Sorry if I seem a bit unfriendly, but I've just had it with this nonsense!
snippets.TROY_TRANSITION_63: Who is doing this to me? Who is strong enough to move a whole kiosk? It's really heavy, this hut!
snippets.TROY_TRANSITION_64: I just don't get it. And the freshly made pancake dough was stolen too!
snippets.TROY_TRANSITION_66: And here I stand again with no pancakes!
snippets.TROY_TRANSITION_67: Sorry $$name$$, I have to ask you to come back again tomorrow. It's a shame but what else can I do?
snippets.TROY_TRANSITION_68: I'll try to stay alert tonight. Maybe I'll catch the muscle man who keeps moving my shop!
snippets.TROY_TRANSITION_71: The same thing every day: My shop moves from one place to another. How is that even possible?!
snippets.TROY_TRANSITION_72: It just won't fit into my brain how something like that even happens!
snippets.TROY_TRANSITION_73: Who pushes my shop around and eats up my pancakes?!
snippets.TROY_TRANSITION_74: A shop like that is way too heavy for a normal Panda to even push let alone lift!
snippets.TROY_TRANSITION_75: This has to stop! Otherwise I'm out of business!
snippets.TROY_TRANSITION_76: Alert, alert! The pancake thief has been detected! It's Paul the kid!
snippets.TROY_TRANSITION_77: I knew he wasn't a normal Panda, he can do magic!
snippets.TROY_TRANSITION_78: How else could he have dragged a heavy kiosk into his room half way through Panfu?!
snippets.TROY_TRANSITION_79: Who knows what Paul the kid can move! My tree house maybe? The castle? Or a whole island?
snippets.TROY_TRANSITION_80: We should have an eye on him in the future. You never know what he can get up to with these powers of his.
snippets.TROY_TRANSITION_81: First we need to snatch away my shop from him! Please wake Paul the kid up so he'll let go of my kiosk.
snippets.TROY_TRANSITION_82: How? I don't really know... Maybe a cold shower would do good! Or something of the sort...
snippets.TROY_TRANSITION_83: Pssst! I hid some pancakes. I'll give them to you when you've managed to wake Paul the kid up. But don't tell him about them!
snippets.TROY_TRANSITION_84: Please wake Paul the kid up so I can finally put my shop back into the city. Maybe you should throw some cold water on him?
snippets.TROY_TRANSITION_85: Neat! I'll call a tow truck immediately to tow my shop back to its original spot.
snippets.TROY_TRANSITION_86A: Your pancakes are now in your furniture box! Catch you round in the city. See you then!
snippets.TROY_TRANSITION_86B: Hey, your Pancakes are waiting for you in your Furniture Chest! But don't forget about them, they won't last. After 5 days, they will spoil and then disappear from your Inventory. Catch you in the city, see you then!
